basics.name: Roger Li
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer who came up through bioengineering research and a few years in product management. Builds frontend features now, and knows the roadmap conversations around them.

work.summary: Frontend work in React, building the views that render log and telemetry records. Recently a dark mode pass across the app, much of it done with AI tooling.

work.name: Jumbo
work.summary: Shipped several iOS features and helped move the product from B2C to B2B2C, where convincing partner companies to buy in was harder than the engineering. Set roadmaps and used analytics to prioritize.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Ran the process across three teams as product owner and scrum master, more organizing and unblocking than deciding what to build. Talked to clients directly.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Built prototypes so product teams knew what a feature would cost. Rewrote the API docs and stood up a public version for a client evaluating our new RESTful v2.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Built features and systems end to end. Rebuilt the email notification system, which couldn't handle the dozens of event types planned for it. Shipped about a dozen integrations, including Amazon Ads, and led the team.

work.name: Epic Systems
work.summary: Guided clients through software rollouts, recommending configurations that fit their workflows and hitting fixed launch dates.

work.name: Healmet
work.summary: Helped plan a prototype for detecting basic vitals (heart rate, oxygen saturation, EKG), much like an Apple Watch does today.

work.name: University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center
work.summary: Supported a lab studying OCT imaging of coronary arteries and improved how patient data was tracked.
